Cortisol drives the stress response through the glucocorticoid receptor [1].

The response is conserved across teleosts and is supported by prior work [2].

References
[1] Smith, A. L., & Jones, B. (2020). Stress signaling in teleost fish. Journal of Comparative Physiology, 210(4), 345-360. https://doi.org/10.1000/one
[2] Johnson, C. D. (2022). Conserved pathways in teleost stress adaptation. Comparative Biochemistry and Physiology, 190(2), 100-118. https://doi.org/10.1000/two
